name: Dry wood (tinder, kindling)
notes: Old, dry, light timber: kindling, woodpiles, rotten boards, weathered fences. Catches earlier than seasoned wood (250 °C) and burns hotter and faster (90 s for a typical piece). Density 450 kg/m³ (dry pine). Weaker (60 hp) and a little creakier underfoot (creaking boards are the wood-hollow surface; footstepLoudness equals the wood surface row, 2 dB, so one floor has one number). Burns to charred remains (mw-e03.5). Medium surface that rope arrows embed in (softAnchor), like seasoned wood. (mw-e03.31)
